title: This Excel Formula Missed $3,600 (Spot the Error) #shorts
description: An invoice total looks correct—but the formula misses the last record. This fictional Excel example shows how to trace SUM ranges, spot omitted rows, and verify totals before trusting a formula suggestion. #excel #formulas #exceltips #shorts

captions.text: A perfect-looking formula can still be wrong.
It sums four invoices, not five.
Check the entire range. Then verify the total.
The formula is valid. The answer was wrong.

visual_note: Illustrative worksheet reconstruction, precise numeric audit, no claim that Copilot produced the wrong suggestion.
